channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Lasting Truce Is Elusive After Week of Traded Attacks
item.description: Russian and Ukrainian forces continued to exchange attacks, making a lasting truce elusive. The violence has persisted despite international efforts to broker a ceasefire. The situation remains volatile in the region.

item.title: Xiangshan Forum prelude concludes with focus on global security challenges - 巴士的報
item.description: The Xiangshan Forum prelude concluded with a focus on global security challenges. Chinese officials emphasized the need for cooperation to address these challenges. The forum is a key platform for regional security discussions.

item.title: WHO chief reassures Tenerife residents ahead of arrival of virus-hit cruise ship
item.description: The World Health Organization chief, Tedros Ghebreyesus, reassured residents of Tenerife about the arrival of a virus-hit cruise ship. The ship is expected to dock on Sunday, and health officials are preparing to receive it. The island's residents are on high alert.

item.title: Putin says he thinks the war with Ukraine 'is coming to an end' as Trump-brokered 3-day ceasefire
item.description: Russian President Putin said he believes the war with Ukraine is coming to an end. A three-day ceasefire brokered by former US President Trump has begun. The ceasefire aims to reduce violence in the region.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israeli strikes killed 39 people in Lebanon, despite a ceasefire deal announced last month. Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: For the first time, Putin says he’s open to meeting Zelensky outside Russia
item.description: Vladimir Putin expressed a willingness to meet Ukrainian President Zelensky outside Russia for the first time. The Russian leader's tone has shifted, indicating a potential shift in diplomatic efforts. The meeting's details have not been finalized.

item.title: Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan
item.description: A car bomb attack in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killed three police officers. Bomber and several fighters detonate explosives-laden vehicle near security post in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan.

item.title: Putin says Ukraine war winding down, blasts West for backing Kyiv
item.description: Russian President Putin stated the Ukraine war is winding down, criticizing the West for supporting Ukraine. He also expressed a willingness to meet Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, but only after conditions for a potential peace agreement are met.

item.title: Venezuela’s Delcy Rodriguez heads to The Hague for land dispute case
item.description: Delcy Rodriguez travels to The Hague for a land dispute case between Venezuela and Guyana. Trip to be first time Rodriguez has left Caribbean since Maduro abduction, will attend ICJ case on Guyana land dispute.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal at ‘own pace’ as Trump awaits response, says report
item.description: Iran reviews a US proposal at its own pace, with no immediate response expected. The report said expectations had grown that Tehran would issue a response after U. S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated that Washington was expecting an answer from Iran.

item.title: Putin says Ukraine war likely to end soon - despite Ukrainian battlefield gains
item.description: President Vladimir Putin said the Ukraine war is likely to end soon, despite Ukrainian battlefield gains. President Vladimir Putin has said he believes the Ukraine war is coming to an end.

item.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine war is 'coming to an end'
item.description: Putin said the Ukraine war is coming to an end as a three-day ceasefire began. Moscow and Kyiv are observing the truce. The Russian president made the remarks as Moscow and Kyiv observe a three-day ceasefire in their four-year conflict.

item.title: Vladimir Putin On Russia's War With Ukraine
item.description: Putin stated Russia's war with Ukraine needs European governments to make the first move. The Kremlin made this statement last week. The Kremlin said last week that it was for European governments to make the first move.

item.title: All Aboard Hantavirus-Hit Ship 'High-Risk Contact', Must Be Monitored: WHO
item.description: The WHO declared all aboard a hantavirus-hit ship as high-risk contacts. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is heading to Tenerife. All Aboard Hantavirus-Hit Ship 'High-Risk Contact', Must Be Monitored: WHO.

item.title: Greece conducts controlled blast of mystery naval drone explosives
item.description: Greek authorities conducted a controlled explosion of a naval drone found in a cave by fishermen. The unmanned vessel, suspected to be of Ukrainian origin, was discovered on Thursday. The unmanned vessel, suspected to be of Ukrainian origin, was found by fishermen in a cave on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Sailor Dies, 4 Injured After Boat Catches Fire, Sinks Near Hormuz
item.description: An Indian sailor died and four others were injured when their boat caught fire and sank near Hormuz. The cause of the fire has not been determined yet. The exact cause of the fire is yet to be ascertained.

item.title: Rubio defends new U.S. sanctions on Cuba, targeting military-run conglomerate GAESA
item.description: The US imposes new sanctions on Cuba's military-run GAESA conglomerate. Established in the 1990s under military control, GAESA was the Cuban Armed Forces' strategic response to the economic collapse that followed the Soviet Union's fall and the tightening of U. S.

item.title: Iran-US ceasefire holds amid fresh Strait of Hormuz tensions; Bahrain arrests dozens over alleged
item.description: A ceasefire between Iran and the US holds amid rising tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran-US ceasefire holds amid fresh Strait of Hormuz tensions; Bahrain arrests dozens over alleged.

item.title: UN mission in Democratic Republic of Congo warns of wave of attacks in east
item.description: The UN mission in Democratic Republic of Congo warns of attacks in the east. The mineral-rich eastern DRC has been plagued for three decades by conflict involving various armed groups, militia and army troops.

item.title: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut kill four; southern airstrikes claim at least 13 lives
item.description: Israeli drone strikes near Beirut killed four people and southern airstrikes killed at least 13. The Israeli military said Hezbollah fired explosive drones into Israel near the border with Lebanon adding that three soldiers were wounded, one of them seriously, in one of the attacks.
